svg.title: A tuple names one intersection
svg.desc: An animation of a 4 by 4 grid, x numbered 0 to 3 along the bottom and y 0 to 3 up the left, with Python beside it. position = (2, 3) makes a tuple of two boxes, 2 at index 0 and 3 at index 1, and labels that intersection. position[0] is 2, drawn as 2 across; position[1] is 3, drawn as 3 away. position[0] = 5 is crossed out with a TypeError: a tuple cannot be changed. Moving one step east makes a new tuple, (3, 3), beside the old (2, 3). (1, 2) == (1, 2) is True, the same spot; (1, 2) == (2, 1) is False, a different spot. Finally the distance from (0, 0) to (2, 3): 2 across plus 3 away, 5 steps, each step numbered on the grid.

g.text: Index 0 is x, index 1 is y
Python counts from zero, like the grid
a tuple can't be changed once made
one step east: x + 1, a new value
both parts match, in order: same spot
